searchText: BTW, I am not sure this was discussed or not. Who is going to determine gas limit after "The merge" ? Beacon validators, or it is going to be Bitcoin-style core dev decisions? <@!203220829473996800> could you pin this message to this channel? I'm afraid it may be hard to find in a couple of days The minimal merge changes as little as possible so the block producing validator could vary Gas limit under the same rules as miners can today.
